_meta.source: hand-curated v0 — see scripts/build_neurosynth_lookup.py for the planned NiMARE regeneration

schema.name: Plain-English anatomical name (hemisphere + region).
schema.category: Coarse functional grouping used by the layman summary; one of vision_low, vision_ventral, motion, auditory, language, somatomotor, attention, salience, default_mode, executive, reward_emotion, social_cognition.
schema.function: One-sentence layman description of what this region typically does.
schema.terms: list[str] of Neurosynth-style cognitive descriptors (kept for backwards-compatibility).
schema.score: float in [0, 1], placeholder for term-association correlation.

categories.vision_low: Early visual cortex — edges, orientation, basic visual features.
categories.vision_ventral: Ventral visual stream — object recognition, faces, scenes, color.
categories.motion: Visual motion processing — direction and speed of moving things.
categories.somatomotor: Body sense and movement — touch, motor commands.
categories.salience: Salience and interoception — what to attend to, body state.
categories.default_mode: Default mode network — mind wandering, self-referential thought, memory.
categories.executive: Cognitive control — conflict, working memory, planning.
categories.social_cognition: Theory of mind, biological motion, social inference.

L_FFC.name: Left fusiform face complex
L_FFC.function: Specialised for recognising faces and other familiar visual objects.

R_FFC.name: Right fusiform face complex
R_FFC.function: Specialised for recognising faces; typically stronger than the left for faces.

R_V1.name: Right primary visual cortex (V1)
R_V1.function: First cortical visual area; processes edges, orientation, basic features.

R_V2.name: Right secondary visual cortex (V2)
R_V2.function: Second-stage visual processing; extends V1 with more complex shapes.

R_V3.name: Right visual area V3
R_V3.function: Mid-level visual area; contributes to form and motion analysis.

R_V4.function: Colour and complex-shape processing in the ventral visual stream.

R_MT.name: Right middle temporal area (MT)
